headline: Crypto TVL, DEX volumes and stablecoin data for 15 November 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $37.6bn, followed by Base at $5.1bn and Solana at $4.6bn. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.77bn while Tether led fees at $17.0m. USDT circulating supply stands at $175.4bn and USDC at $69.3bn, with three stablecoins showing peg deviations. Multiple incidents occurred in the prior 14 days across several chains and protocols.
